snippet.title: FARSIGHT | Midsummer Night's Scream: A HORROR GAME AWARDS SHOWCASE 2026
snippet.description:
Taking a routine eye exam leads to something far stranger. Farsight is a first-person horror set inside the house seen inside an eye exam machine. Navigate the spaces and carry a handheld that takes photos revealing things your eyes can't see.

Wishlist - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3080520/Farsight
Discord - https://discord.com/invite/h9SDBpUWgP
Website - https://farsightgame.com/
---
Originally aired during MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Monday 1 June 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
